description: Source code for the WorkerPage class in Apache Spark's deploy worker UI, responsible for rendering worker details, executors, and drivers in the Spark web UI.

classes.name: WorkerPage
classes.description: A web UI page class for displaying Spark worker details, executors, and drivers.

methods.name: renderJson
methods.description: Returns the worker state as JSON.

methods.name: formatWorkerResourcesDetails
methods.description: Formats the worker's resource details into an HTML string.

methods.name: render
methods.description: Generates the HTML content for the worker page, including executors and drivers tables.

methods.name: executorRow
methods.description: Creates an HTML table row for an executor.

methods.name: driverRow
methods.description: Creates an HTML table row for a driver.
